To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ERP implementation has a positive effect on BMI and that organizational complexity mediats between ERP and BMI.
ERP implementation is associated with a greater level of complexity that, in turn, is related to a higher level of business model innovation (BIM).
the organizational complexity of a firm that has implemented ERP is a mediating factor between ERP and BMI.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of ERP in BMI and the mediating role played by organizational complexity.
how ERP implementation affects the BMI of a firm.
the mediating effect of organizational complexity between the implementation of ERP and the BMI of the firms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the implementation of ERP in firms is a great opportunity to innovate the business model and to improve revenue and cost, but this opportunity is not free of drawbacks, such as organizational complexity, which is a great challenge for the firm.
organizational complexity has a mediating effect between the ERP and BMI, so that ERP implementation has a positive influence on BMI through organizational complexity.
the implementation of ERP systems is a complex process and the implementation of a new business model requires a high level of organizational complexity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ERP is a key factor to improve organizational complexity, and this, in turn, will lead to BMI.
ERP implementation can be an enabler for BMI, but it also requires a higher organizational complexity that can hinder BMI.
organizational complexity is the main barrier to the implementation and the use of ERP systems, and that it is the main barrier for firms that are trying to be more innovative.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the ERP software is a powerful tool for BMI, but only if the firm is able to implement the ERP software in the organization without creating too much organizational complexity.
the implementation of ERP is a good opportunity to improve organizational complexity and therefore the firm’s ability to innovate its business model.
the organizational structure should not be neglected when implementing ERP, since it could be a key factor to achieve the expected return on investment and the associated BMI.
